assessments.analysis: Moving created dispatch after construction of the disposal closure preserves setup-before-created-before-first-render order. When created throws, the session is not returned; disposal executes while owner capabilities remain readable. BeforeDispose still sees live State; logical resources retire before the host revokes wiring. Original failure identity is preserved alone if cleanup succeeds, otherwise as AggregateError.errors[0]. The cleanup error—including falsy throws—is preserved as the second member. Diagnostic/author cleanup errors keep encounter order, and shared disposal completion is installed before callbacks can reenter.

assessments.analysis: Checking instancePhase before consuming the active task prevents a terminal diagnostic flush from removing it from the pending set before host cancellation. Task.cancel invalidates before invoking host cancellation and remains idempotent. Tests retain runtime callback scope/setup guards and add four diagnostic points plus exact cancel counts and stale-generation suppression.

The internal Anatomy port is cached after successful owner initialization and cleared at terminal afterUnmount. Retained reconnect captures the accepted logical parent, clears a stale nonportal projection, resolves the current destination and explicitly synchronizes Anatomy for live/detached owners. Immediate structural rejection restores the previous logical parent and resynchronizes; rollback failure preserves both errors. Portal ownership, owner identity, terminal token replacement and resource disposal remain separate.
